newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Hua Nan Bank cuts prime lending rate.
newsitem.headline: Hua Nan Bank cuts prime lending rate.

text.p: Hua Nan Bank, one of Taiwan's Big Three state banks, is cutting its prime lending rate by 0.025 percentage points to 7.525 percent from 7.550, effective on Monday, the state-funded Central News Agency reported on Saturday.
The agency said Hua Nan was also cutting its various time deposit rates by 0.25 percentage points.

Another Big Three state bank, First Commercial Bank, announced earlier on Saturday that it was cutting its prime lending rate by 0.025 percentage points to 7.525 percent from 7.550 and one-month-to-three-year time deposits rates by between 0.10 and 0.20 percentage points, effective from Monday.
